payload.reason: Resolve the alerted checkout service to its graph id.
Resolve the alerted checkout service to its graph id.
payload.cypher:
MATCH (viewer:Person {id: $viewer})
MATCH (n)
WHERE labels(n)[0] IN ['Service', 'Person', 'Team', 'Role', 'Channel', 'Repo', 'CodeModule',
                       'PR', 'Deploy', 'Ticket', 'Thread', 'Doc', 'Decision', 'Incident', 'Alert']
  AND (n.id IN $ids
       OR toLower(n.name) CONTAINS toLower($text)
       OR toLower(n.title) CONTAINS toLower($text))
WITH viewer, n,
     coalesce(n.access_level, CASE WHEN 'Deploy' IN labels(n) THEN 'internal' END) AS level
WITH viewer, n, level
WHERE level IS NULL
   OR level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(n)
OPTIONAL MATCH (owner:Team)-[:OWNS]->(n)
RETURN n.id AS id,
       labels(n)[0] AS label,
       coalesce(n.name, n.title) AS name,
       n.tier AS tier,
       n.access_level AS access_level,
       owner.id AS owner_team
ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.id IN $ids THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
         CASE WHEN labels(n)[0] IN ['Service', 'Team', 'Person'] THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
         name
LIMIT 10

payload.reason: Find past incidents similar to checkout p99 latency > 3s.
Find past incidents similar to checkout p99 latency > 3s.
payload.cypher:
MATCH (viewer:Person {id: $viewer})
CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Chunk', 'embedding', $fetch_k, vecf32($qvec)) YIELD node AS c, score
MATCH (c)-[:PART_OF]->(inc:Incident)
WHERE inc.access_level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(inc)
WITH viewer, inc, c, score
ORDER BY score ASC
WITH viewer, inc, collect(c)[0] AS best, collect(score)[0] AS score
ORDER BY score ASC
LIMIT $k
OPTIONAL MATCH (inc)-[:AFFECTED]->(s:Service)
WITH viewer, inc, best, score, collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS services
OPTIONAL MATCH (inc)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (inc)-[:CAUSED_BY]->(pr:PR)
WHERE pr.access_level IN $open_levels
   OR (viewer)-[:MEMBER_OF|HAS_ROLE|IN_CHANNEL]->()<-[:VISIBLE_TO]-(pr)
RETURN inc.id AS id,
       coalesce(inc.name, inc.title) AS title,
       inc.severity AS severity,
       inc.started_at AS started_at,
       inc.access_level AS access_level,
       best.text AS text,
       best.id AS chunk_id,
       score,
       services,
       p.id AS resolved_by,
       pr.id AS caused_by
ORDER BY score ASC
